name: State virtual-cell query
description: Query the locally registered State checkpoint using a supplied PredictionRequest JSON. Checks applicability and endpoint support before inference. Returns typed predictions or named refusals, never measurements. Paper: https://www.cell.com/cell/fulltext/S0092-8674(26)00921-9; consult data/knowledge/research_sources.json for version and access limitations.
use_when: A complete registered prediction request is supplied and planning needs a supported transcriptional readout.
do_not_use_when: A measured phenotype, target occupancy, causal mechanism, unregistered perturbation or unvalidated cross-endpoint bridge is required.
